import itertools
from functools import partial
import icontract

def unique_array_sum_combinations(A, B, C, target):
    """
    1. Sort all the arrays - a,b,c. - This improves average time complexity.
    2. If c[i] < Sum, then look for Sum - c[i] in array a and b.
       When pair found, insert c[i], a[j] & b[k] into the result list.
       This can be done in O(n).
    3. Keep on doing the above procedure while going through complete c array.

    Complexity: O(n(m+p))
    """
    A.sort()
    B.sort()
    C.sort()
    result = []
    for i in range(len(C)):
        remaining_sum = target - C[i]
        left = 0
        right = len(A) - 1
        while left < len(A) and right >= 0:
            current_sum = A[left] + B[right]
            if current_sum == remaining_sum:
                result.append([A[left], B[right], C[i]])
                left += 1
                right -= 1
            elif current_sum < remaining_sum:
                left += 1
            else:
                right -= 1
    
    # Remove duplicates using set of tuples
    unique_result = []
    seen = set()
    for combination in result:
        tuple_combination = tuple(sorted(combination))
        if tuple_combination not in seen:
            unique_result.append(combination)
            seen.add(tuple_combination)
    return unique_result
